description: Canonical label taxonomy for Image-Toolkit. Consumed by sync_backlog.py to validate/create labels and by agent_tools.py to route tickets to Project V2 fields. Component/priority names mirror the dropdown options in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/{bug_agent,feature_agent}.yml ("Core: C++ Base", "Tier 1: Core Engine", etc.) so tickets filed via either path share one taxonomy.

components.name: component:cpp-base
components.description: base/ C++ core (image processing, crawling, sync)

components.name: component:python-backend
components.description: backend/ Python orchestrator (DB, ML, web wrappers)

components.name: component:ci-automation
components.description: GitHub Actions, bots, and repo automation

priority.name: priority:tier1-core-engine
priority.description: Tier 1: Core Engine -- foundational, blocks other work

priority.name: priority:tier2-qa-prototype
priority.description: Tier 2: QA Prototype -- validates an approach before productionizing

priority.name: priority:tier3-production-app
priority.description: Tier 3: Production App -- user-facing feature work

status.name: status:backlog
status.description: Not yet assessed by agent or maintainer

agent.name: agent:generated
agent.description: Ticket authored by sync_backlog.py from roadmap/changelog

agent.name: agent:needs-human
agent.description: Agent flagged ambiguity requiring maintainer input
